name: Helpshift
tagline: Helpshift is a digital customer service platform built for mobile apps and games, with AI chatbots, in-app messaging, and smart intent detection. Its AI classifies incoming issues and routes them to the right team or resolves them automatically. Top game studios and mobile-first brands use it for 24/7 automated support.
